banner.title: Growth has the lead. Confirmation is still missing.
banner.label: MIXED
banner.limitation: A fictional prior-close map, with no current premarket prices or broad-market breadth.

summary.text: In this fictional sample, growth still has an edge over the broad equity benchmark on the prior session, and the previous close's read carries into this session unchanged: QQQ finished ahead of SPY, while the selected mega-cap's longer-window advance was stronger still. Breadth remains unmeasured.

The useful tension is beneath the headline: front-end yields eased while the longer end rose, and the gold fund advanced while miners slipped. Those relationships leave confirmation as the next check rather than a single risk-on story.

macro.text: The front-end move was {{treasury-2y-change}}, against {{treasury-10y-change}} at the longer end. Calling that simply lower rates would hide the curve's divergence. The gold fund and miners also moved in opposite directions.
macro.uncertainty: These are dated daily observations, not evidence of a premarket reaction.
macro.alternative: Different duration exposure and company-specific effects may explain some of the contrast.

equities.text: QQQ's prior-session return was {{QQQ-daily}}, compared with {{SPY-daily}} for SPY. The sample suggests a growth preference, while exchange breadth and index weights remain unavailable.

events.text: The fictional survey is a scheduled observation point. Its result and survey consensus are absent, so there is no basis to characterize a surprise or to assign it a price effect.

attention.why: NVDA's relative leadership matters because it tests whether growth participation extends beyond the broad benchmark.
XLI's moving-average transition matters because cyclical participation can confirm or weaken the growth-led map.

watches.condition: If growth retains its lead after regular trading begins, check whether participation extends beyond the selected mega-cap.
watches.confirmation: More independently observed sectors improve on synchronized comparisons.
watches.contradiction: The benchmark lead persists while participation narrows.

watches.condition: Revisit the gold fund and miners on the same return horizon.
watches.confirmation: Miners join the metal fund's strength.
watches.contradiction: Miner weakness persists despite firmness in the gold fund.

character.text: A growth-led, mixed fictional map: the benchmark edge sits with QQQ while the curve and metals send conflicting signals.
